take: Toronto announced it placed center John Tavares on injured reserve and sent center Dakota Joshua to the AHL for conditioning. Tavares had two goals and five assists in seven games, and Toronto controlled just 30% of the 5-on-5 chance quality (expected goals) with him on the ice. In the two games without him, Colton Sissons has taken his spot beside Nylander and McKenna, Gavin McKenna has moved onto the first power-play unit, and Zack MacEwen is up to 7:50 a night from 5:27.
